### `GET /api/v1/repositories`

List repositories

List all repositories with optional filtering

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | query | string | no | Filter by package format. One of: `deb`, `rpm`, `maven`, `npm`, `docker`, `helm`, `pypi`, `nuget`, `go`, `cargo`, `rubygems`, `raw`, `conda`, `conan`, `ivy`, `sbt`. |
| `page` | query | integer | no | Page number (default: 1). Minimum: 1. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Items per page (default: 25, max: 100). Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List of repositories | `application/json`: object |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| `limit` | integer | no | - |
| `page` | integer | no | - |
| `repositories` | array of [Repository](schemas.md#repository) | no | - |
| `total` | integer | no | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories`

Create repository

Create a new repository (admin only)

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blocked` | boolean | no | - |
| `cache_ttl_seconds` | integer | no | - |
| `description` | string | no | - |
| `federated` | boolean | no | Enable federation at creation. Only valid for hosted repositories of the formats raw, maven, npm, docker, helm, pypi, cargo, go and nuget (400 otherwise when true). |
| `format` | string | yes | One of: `deb`, `rpm`, `maven`, `npm`, `docker`, `helm`, `pypi`, `nuget`, `go`, `cargo`, `rubygems`, `raw`, `conda`, `conan`, `ivy`, `sbt`. |
| `immutable_releases` | boolean | no | When true, deleting or overwriting a released version is refused with 409 (SNAPSHOT/pre-release versions stay mutable). An admin can override with ?force=true. |
| `max_stale_seconds` | integer | no | Seconds past a cached file's expiry during which it may still be served, with a Warning: 110 header, when the upstream is unreachable, times out or answers 5xx. 0 disables serve-stale; default 604800 (7 days); max 31536000. |
| `member_repos` | array of string | no | For group repos: ordered member repository names (first hit wins). Members must be hosted or proxy repositories of the group's format; groups cannot be nested. |
| `merge_proxy_versions` | boolean | no | Group repositories only, administrators only (403 otherwise). Default false: hosted members win a package name and proxy versions of the same name are hidden. true merges proxy versions into the group. |
| `name` | string | yes | Repository name (1-100 alphanumeric/hyphen/underscore) |
| `negative_cache_ttl_seconds` | integer | no | - |
| `presign_downloads` | boolean | no | Per-repository override of storage.presignDownloads: true always redirects eligible blob downloads to a presigned object-store URL, false always streams, null inherits the global setting. Metadata and manifests are never redirected. Nullable. |
| `project` | string | no | Name of the owning project. Defaults to the built-in system project, whose membership grants nothing. Unknown project: 404. |
| `public` | boolean | no | - |
| `repo_type` | string | no | hosted (default), proxy or group. Proxy repositories are supported for maven, deb, rpm, docker, go, npm, nuget, pypi, cargo, helm and raw; group repositories for maven, deb, rpm, docker, go, npm, nuget, pypi, cargo, helm and raw (deb and rpm groups serve generated Release/Packages or repodata merged across their members). Docker proxies and groups are served under /v2/ only. Other combinations are rejected with 400 validation_failed. Proxy and group repositories are read-only. One of: `hosted`, `proxy`, `group`. |
| `sign_packages` | boolean | no | Hosted rpm repositories only (400 otherwise when true). When true, uploaded RPMs are signed with the active GPG key; existing packages are not re-signed. |
| `trash_retention_days` | integer | no | Days a deleted item (or the repository itself) stays restorable in the trash before the retention purge removes it. null/absent = the server default (TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS); 0 = no trash, deletes are immediate and permanent. Nullable. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 36500. |
| `upstream_password` | string | no | - |
| `upstream_url` | string | no | Required for proxy repos, except docker (defaults to https://registry-1.docker.io), nuget (defaults to the service index https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json), pypi (defaults to https://pypi.org/simple) cargo (defaults to https://index.crates.io) and go (defaults to https://proxy.golang.org). Plain http(s) base URL without credentials, query or fragment; validated against the outbound (SSRF) policy. |
| `upstream_username` | string | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Repository created | `application/json`: [Repository](schemas.md#repository) |
| `400` | Invalid request | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `409` | A repository with this name already exists, or the name is reserved by a repository in the trash until it is purged or restored (error codes conflict, name_reserved) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/license/scan`

Scan licenses

Detect the licenses of an artifact from its stored package file (the wheel METADATA, package.json, Cargo.toml, .nuspec, pom or gemspec it declares) and from its license properties, evaluate the license policies and record the result. A violated policy with action `block` quarantines the artifact: downloads answer 403 `ARTIFACT_QUARANTINED` until an admin approves it.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact_id` | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | License scan result with the policy violations | `application/json`: [LicenseScanRunResult](schemas.md#licensescanrunresult) |
| `400` | Invalid body | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `422` | The artifact's metadata is too large or ambiguous to be read safely (`unsafe_artifact`), or its license cannot be read from its file while a blocking license policy applies (`unreadable_artifact`) | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/license/scans/{id}/quarantine`

Quarantine or approve license scan artifact

Quarantine (`quarantined: true`) or approve (`quarantined: false`) the artifact of a license scan (admin only). An artifact quarantined by a blocking license policy stays quarantined, also across re-scans of the same licenses, until it is approved here.

| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quarantined` | boolean | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Updated license scan | `application/json`: [LicenseScanResult](schemas.md#licensescanresult) |
| `400` | Invalid body | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Repository or scan not found | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/repositories/{name}/packages/{id}`

Delete a package

Delete a package row (an id of the package listing) from a hosted repository of any format: into the trash when the repository keeps one, else for good, refreshing the format's generated metadata. A conan recipe revision goes with its files. Released versions of immutable repositories answer 409 unless an admin passes force. Requires write access.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | Repository name |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Package ID |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Package deleted | `application/json`: [PackageDeleteResult](schemas.md#packagedeleteresult) |
| `404` | Repository or package not found | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `409` | Release versions are immutable in this repository | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/packages/{id}/delta`

Download a binary delta

Returns a binary diff that turns the package whose sha256 is given in `from` into the target package. The delta is generated on demand and cached. Applies to rpm and deb packages. Requires read access.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | Repository name |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Target package ID |
| `from` | query | string | yes | sha256 (64 hex characters) of the package the client already has. Pattern: `^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Binary delta Headers: `X-Delta-From`, `X-Delta-Size`, `X-Delta-To`. | `application/octet-stream`: string (binary) |
| `400` | Missing or invalid from | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `404` | Repository, target or source package not found | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `413` | Package too large for delta generation | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

| `200` | Package file | `application/octet-stream`: string (binary) |

| `404` | Repository not found | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/sbom/generate`

Generate SBOM

Generate a Software Bill of Materials for a repository artifact. Components are the dependencies declared by the stored package file (manifest and lockfile) merged with the artifact's `dependencies` property.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact_id` | string (uuid) | yes | - |
| `format` | string | yes | `cyclonedx` (JSON), `spdx` (2.3 tag-value), `spdx-json` (2.3 JSON) or `spdx3-json` (SPDX 3.0.1 JSON-LD). One of: `cyclonedx`, `spdx`, `spdx-json`, `spdx3-json`. |
| `metadata` | object | no | - |
| `spec_version` | string | no | CycloneDX 1.4, 1.5 (default) or 1.6; SPDX 2.3; SPDX 3 3.0.1. Optional. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/uploads`

Start a presigned upload

Hosted raw repositories on any storage backend with a staging area: S3-compatible and GCS (presigned URLs), Azure (SAS URLs), and the filesystem and OCI registry backends (short-lived HMAC-signed URLs served by this server, which need `baseUrl` to be set). Returns a short-lived presigned PUT URL to a staging object; upload the bytes directly to it, then call the complete endpoint. Files above 5 GiB (up to 5 TiB) must set `multipart`: the response then carries the part plan instead of a URL, and each part URL comes from the parts endpoint. Requires write permission on the repository and on the path. The response carries a bearer credential and is sent with Cache-Control: no-store. A user may have at most storage.presignMaxPendingUploads uploads outstanding (not completed, not expired).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [PresignedUploadRequest](schemas.md#presigneduploadrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Upload target | `application/json`: [PresignedUpload](schemas.md#presignedupload) |
| `400` | Invalid path, size, part size or sha256 (code invalid_size also when a size above 5 GiB lacks `multipart`, or is too large for a single upload on Azure), or the repository is not a hosted raw repository | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `401` | Authentication required | - |
| `403` | Write permission denied | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `429` | Too many outstanding uploads for this user (retry after the Retry-After header) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `501` | The storage backend does not support presigned uploads | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/uploads/{id}/abort`

Abort a presigned upload

Discards an upload that will not be completed: the staging object, the parts uploaded so far and the upload record. Only the creator of the upload or an administrator may abort it. Abandoned uploads are also swept automatically after they expire.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | The upload was discarded | - |
| `401` | Authentication required | - |
| `403` | Write permission denied, or the caller is neither the creator of the upload nor an administrator | - |
| `404` | Repository or upload not found (or expired and swept) | - |
| `409` | Code upload_completed: the upload is already completed. Code upload_in_progress: a complete is running (retry after the Retry-After header) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `501` | The storage backend does not support presigned uploads | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/uploads/{id}/complete`

Complete a presigned upload

Verifies that the staged object has the declared size and sha256, moves it to its content-addressed key, records the artifact (overwriting an existing path, like a raw PUT) and deletes the staging object. Only the creator of the upload or an administrator may complete it. The server reads the object back (up to 5 TiB) in a detached job (30 minutes plus about one second per 20 MiB, at most 6 hours) that survives a client disconnect; the read and the move are conditional on the object version seen at verification, so an object re-uploaded in between is refused. The call is idempotent: the first success returns 201, a retry returns 200 with the same body, and a retry while a verification is running returns 409 upload_in_progress. On a size or sha256 mismatch, or when the object changed during verification, the staging object and the upload are discarded and nothing is recorded. The repository's storage quota is enforced (507 quota_exceeded: the upload stays pending, nothing is recorded, and completing again after freeing space works); license and secret scanning are not applied, as for a raw PUT.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |
| `force` | query | boolean | no | Administrators only: `true` overwrites an existing file of a repository with `immutable_releases`. Ignored for everyone else. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The upload was already completed; the original result | `application/json`: [PresignedUploadResult](schemas.md#presigneduploadresult) |
| `201` | Artifact recorded | `application/json`: [PresignedUploadResult](schemas.md#presigneduploadresult) |
| `400` | The repository is not a hosted raw repository | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `401` | Authentication required | - |
| `403` | Write permission denied, or the caller is neither the creator of the upload nor an administrator | - |
| `404` | Repository or upload not found (or expired and swept) | - |
| `409` | Code upload_missing: nothing has been uploaded to the upload URL yet. Code upload_in_progress: another complete is verifying this upload (retry after the Retry-After header). Code upload_incomplete: a part of a multipart upload is missing or has the wrong size (the message names the part numbers; upload them and call complete again). Code upload_changed: the staged object was overwritten during verification; the upload was discarded. Code immutable_release: the path already exists in a repository with `immutable_releases`; nothing was recorded and the upload stays pending (retry with `force=true` as an administrator) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `410` | The upload expired | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `422` | Size or sha256 does not match the declaration; the upload was discarded | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `501` | The storage backend does not support presigned uploads | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `507` | Code quota_exceeded: the repository's storage quota would be exceeded; nothing was recorded and the upload stays pending | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/uploads/{id}/parts`

Sign the parts of a multipart upload

Returns presigned PUT URLs for up to 100 parts of a multipart upload, each for exactly the returned size. Call it as often as needed (URLs live as long as the single-upload URL, and every call extends the upload's deadline), PUT the parts in any order and in parallel, then call complete. A part may be re-uploaded. The response carries bearer credentials and is sent with Cache-Control: no-store. Only the creator of the upload or an administrator may call it.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [PresignedPartsRequest](schemas.md#presignedpartsrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Part upload targets | `application/json`: [PresignedParts](schemas.md#presignedparts) |
| `400` | Code invalid_part_numbers: empty, duplicate, more than 100 or out-of-range part numbers. Code not_multipart: the upload is a single upload | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `401` | Authentication required | - |
| `403` | Write permission denied, or the caller is neither the creator of the upload nor an administrator | - |
| `404` | Repository or upload not found (or expired and swept) | - |
| `409` | Code upload_completed: the upload is already completed | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `410` | The upload expired | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `501` | The storage backend does not support multipart uploads | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/vex`

Download a VEX document

Build an OpenVEX 0.2.0 (default) or CycloneDX VEX document from the latest vulnerability scans and the recorded VEX decisions. With `artifact_id` it covers one artifact, otherwise every scanned artifact of the repository. Status per vulnerability: the recorded decision; else `fixed` when the scan's `fixed_in` is at or below the artifact version; else `affected` when the scan quarantined the artifact; else `under_investigation`. `not_affected` only comes from a recorded decision. Admin only.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `format` | query | string | no | One of: `openvex`, `cyclonedx`. Default: `openvex`. |
| `spec_version` | query | string | no | CycloneDX spec version (1.4, 1.5 or 1.6; default 1.5). CycloneDX only. |
| `artifact_id` | query | string | no | Restrict the document to one artifact (`name@version`). |
| `attest` | query | string | no | `true` returns the document as a signed in-toto attestation in a DSSE envelope; `bundle` returns a Sigstore bundle, the input of `cosign verify-blob-attestation`. Verify with the key from `/.well-known/openartifact/attestation-key.pem`. One of: `true`, `bundle`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | VEX document, or its attestation with `attest` | `application/json`: object; `application/vnd.dev.sigstore.bundle.v0.3+json`: object; `application/vnd.dsse.envelope.v1+json`: object |
| `400` | Invalid format, spec_version or artifact_id | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `501` | Attestations are not enabled | - |

### `PATCH /api/v1/repository/{name}`

Update repository

Update repository configuration. Requires global admin, or the maintainer or owner role in the repository's project; a caller with neither and no read access gets 404. A project maintainer may not send project (use the transfer route), blocked or presign_downloads, nor make the repository public unless the project allows public repositories (403); member_repos must be readable by the caller (403).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blocked` | boolean | no | - |
| `cache_ttl_seconds` | integer | no | - |
| `description` | string | no | - |
| `immutable_releases` | boolean | no | When true, deleting or overwriting a released version is refused with 409 (SNAPSHOT/pre-release versions stay mutable). An admin can override with ?force=true. |
| `max_stale_seconds` | integer | no | Seconds past a cached file's expiry during which it may still be served, with a Warning: 110 header, when the upstream is unreachable, times out or answers 5xx. 0 disables serve-stale; default 604800 (7 days); max 31536000. |
| `member_repos` | array of string | no | - |
| `merge_proxy_versions` | boolean | no | Group repositories only, administrators only (403 otherwise). Absent leaves it unchanged. |
| `negative_cache_ttl_seconds` | integer | no | - |
| `presign_downloads` | boolean | no | Per-repository override of storage.presignDownloads: true always redirects eligible blob downloads to a presigned object-store URL, false always streams, null inherits the global setting. Metadata and manifests are never redirected. Omit to leave unchanged; send null to inherit. Nullable. |
| `project` | string | no | Move the repository to the named project (global admin only; unknown project: 404). Access of the old and new project's members changes immediately. |
| `public` | boolean | no | - |
| `sign_packages` | boolean | no | Hosted rpm repositories only (400 otherwise when true). When true, uploaded RPMs are signed with the active GPG key; existing packages are not re-signed. |
| `trash_retention_days` | integer | no | Absent leaves it unchanged; an explicit null resets it to the server default; 0..36500 sets it (0 = no trash). Nullable. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 36500. |
| `upstream_password` | string | no | - |
| `upstream_url` | string | no | - |
| `upstream_username` | string | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Repository updated | `application/json`: [Repository](schemas.md#repository) |
| `400` | Invalid request (for example trash_retention_days out of range) | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/repository/{name}`

Delete repository (to the trash)

Delete a repository (global admin, or maintainer or owner of its project). The request must confirm the repository name, as the `confirm` query parameter or a JSON body {"confirm": "`<name>`"}; otherwise 400 confirmation_required. When the repository's trash retention is above 0 the repository is moved to the trash (hidden everywhere, its name stays reserved, restorable and purged after the retention window); with retention 0 it is deleted permanently, contents included.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `confirm` | query | string | no | Must equal the repository name (alternatively send it in the JSON body). |

**Request body**

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `confirm` | string | no | Must equal the repository name. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Repository deleted (moved to the trash, or permanently deleted when retention is 0) | - |
| `400` | Missing or mismatched confirmation (error code confirmation_required) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `409` | The repository is still referenced (for example by a release bundle or promotion); only possible when it is deleted permanently | - |
